0x00000001dbef467c  0x00000048  __TEXT,__text  objc  -[DGLevelsFilter floatValueForKey:defaultValue:clearIfNotDefault:]  // -[DGLevelsFilter ?]
0x00000001dbef46c4  0x00000048  __TEXT,__text  objc  -[DGLevelsFilter floatValueForKey:defaultValue:]  // -[DGLevelsFilter ?]

0x00000001dbef501c  0x00000028  __TEXT,__text  objc  +[DGLevelsFilter filterWithName:]  // +[DGLevelsFilter ?]
0x00000001dbef5044  0x00000920  __TEXT,__text  objc  +[DGLevelsFilter initialize]  // +[DGLevelsFilter PA2DBufferMutableTile]
0x00000001dbef5964  0x00000014  __TEXT,__text  objc  -[DGFusionOperation .cxx_destruct]  // -[DGFusionOperation ?]
0x00000001dbef5978  0x0000000c  __TEXT,__text  objc  -[DGFusionOperation setAlignmentParams:]  // -[DGFusionOperation ?]
0x00000001dbef5984  0x00000010  __TEXT,__text  objc  -[DGFusionOperation alignmentParams]  // -[DGFusionOperation ?]
0x00000001dbef5994  0x000000d0  __TEXT,__text  objc  -[DGFusionOperation settingsDictionary]  // -[DGFusionOperation ?]
0x00000001dbef5a64  0x0000006c  __TEXT,__text  objc  -[DGFusionOperation applySettingsDictionary:]  // -[DGFusionOperation ?]
0x00000001dbef5ad0  0x00000090  __TEXT,__text  objc  -[DGFusionOperation initWithOperation:]  // -[DGFusionOperation c4 dodge_code(sampler src, sampler mask, vec4 parms) 
{
    vec4 s = unpremultiply(sample(src, samplerCoord(src))); 
    vec4 s_orig = s; 
    vec3 delta = s.rgb; 
    s.rgb = clamp(s.rgb, vec3(0.0001), vec3(0.9999)); 
    delta -= s.rgb; 
    vec4 m = sample(mask, samplerCoord(mask)); 
    m = m.r * parms; 
    vec4 luma = (s.rrrr + s.gggg + s.bbbb) * 0.33333; 
    float highlightcoeff = luma.x * luma.x * (3.0 - 2.0 * luma.x);
    float shadowcoeff = 1.0 - highlightcoeff;
    m = m * vec4(highlightcoeff, shadowcoeff, highlightcoeff, shadowcoeff);
    vec4 satrgb = max(((luma - s) / (luma - 1.0)), (luma - s) / luma);
    float sat = max(max(satrgb.r, satrgb.g), satrgb.b);
    float satadj = m.z * highlightcoeff + m.w * shadowcoeff;
    sat += sat * satadj * min(1.0, 2.0 - 2.0 * sat * satadj);
    float mult = 1.0 / (luma.x + pow(0.125, m.x * highlightcoeff + m.y * shadowcoeff) * (1.0 - luma.x));
    s *= mult; luma *= mult; 
    satrgb = max(((luma - s) / (luma - 1.0)), (luma - s) / luma);
    float newsat = max(max(satrgb.r, satrgb.g), satrgb.b);
    float satmult = sat / newsat;
    s = luma + (s - luma) * satmult;
    s.a = 1.0;
	 s.rgb += delta; 
    s = vec4(max(s.r, s_orig.r), max(s.g, s_orig.g), max(s.b, s_orig.b), 1.0); 
    return s;

0x00000001dbefec88  0x00000308  __TEXT,__text  func  __30+[DGColorOperation initialize]_block_invoke
0x00000001dbefef90  0x0000000c  __TEXT,__text  objc  +[DGColorOperation _stringsTableName]  // +[DGColorOperation ?]
0x00000001dbefef9c  0x0000000c  __TEXT,__text  objc  -[DGGNGBlurOperation setInputIntensity:]  // -[DGGNGBlurOperation ]
0x00000001dbefefa8  0x00000010  __TEXT,__text  objc  -[DGGNGBlurOperation inputIntensity]  // -[DGGNGBlurOperation ]
0x00000001dbefefb8  0x0000006c  __TEXT,__text  objc  -[DGGNGBlurOperation initWithOperation:]  // -[DGGNGBlurOperation amplerCoord(src))); 
    vec4 s_orig = s; 
    vec3 delta = s.rgb; 
    s.rgb = clamp(s.rgb, vec3(0.0001), vec3(0.9999)); 
    delta -= s.rgb; 
    vec4 m = sample(mask, samplerCoord(mask)); 
    m = m.r * parms; 
    vec4 luma = (s.rrrr + s.gggg + s.bbbb) * 0.33333; 
    float highlightcoeff = luma.x * luma.x * (3.0 - 2.0 * luma.x);
    float shadowcoeff = 1.0 - highlightcoeff;
    m = m * vec4(highlightcoeff, shadowcoeff, highlightcoeff, shadowcoeff);
    vec4 satrgb = max(((luma - s) / (luma - 1.0)), (luma - s) / luma);
    float sat = max(max(satrgb.r, satrgb.g), satrgb.b);
    float satadj = m.z * highlightcoeff + m.w * shadowcoeff;
    sat += sat * satadj * min(1.0, 2.0 - 2.0 * sat * satadj);
    float mult = 1.0 / (luma.x + pow(0.125, m.x * highlightcoeff + m.y * shadowcoeff) * (1.0 - luma.x));
    s *= mult; luma *= mult; 
    satrgb = max(((luma - s) / (luma - 1.0)), (luma - s) / luma);
    float newsat = max(max(satrgb.r, satrgb.g), satrgb.b);
    float satmult = sat / newsat;
    s = luma + (s - luma) * satmult;
    s.a = 1.0;
	 s.rgb += delta; 
    s = vec4(max(s.r, s_orig.r), max(s.g, s_orig.g), max(s.b, s_orig.b), 1.0); 
    return s;
}

0x00000001dbeff9a4  0x00000010  __TEXT,__text  objc  -[DGGNGBurnOperation inputExposure]  // -[DGGNGBurnOperation ?]
0x00000001dbeff9b4  0x0000006c  __TEXT,__text  objc  -[DGGNGBurnOperation initWithOperation:]  // -[DGGNGBurnOperation s.rgb = clamp(s.rgb, vec3(0.0001), vec3(0.9999)); 
    delta -= s.rgb; 
    vec4 m = sample(mask, samplerCoord(mask)); 
    m = m.r * parms; 
    vec4 luma = (s.rrrr + s.gggg + s.bbbb) * 0.33333; 
    float highlightcoeff = luma.x * luma.x * (3.0 - 2.0 * luma.x);
    float shadowcoeff = 1.0 - highlightcoeff;
    m = m * vec4(highlightcoeff, shadowcoeff, highlightcoeff, shadowcoeff);
    vec4 satrgb = max(((luma - s) / (luma - 1.0)), (luma - s) / luma);
    float sat = max(max(satrgb.r, satrgb.g), satrgb.b);
    float satadj = m.z * highlightcoeff + m.w * shadowcoeff;
    sat += sat * satadj * min(1.0, 2.0 - 2.0 * sat * satadj);
    float mult = 1.0 / (luma.x + pow(0.125, m.x * highlightcoeff + m.y * shadowcoeff) * (1.0 - luma.x));
    s *= mult; luma *= mult; 
    satrgb = max(((luma - s) / (luma - 1.0)), (luma - s) / luma);
    float newsat = max(max(satrgb.r, satrgb.g), satrgb.b);
    float satmult = sat / newsat;
    s = luma + (s - luma) * satmult;
    s.a = 1.0;
	 s.rgb += delta; 
    s = vec4(max(s.r, s_orig.r), max(s.g, s_orig.g), max(s.b, s_orig.b), 1.0); 
    return s;
}

0x00000001dbf04bf0  0x0000006c  __TEXT,__text  objc  -[DGGNGMultiplyOperation initWithOperation:]  // -[DGGNGMultiplyOperation c4 satrgb = max(((luma - s) / (luma - 1.0)), (luma - s) / luma);
    float sat = max(max(satrgb.r, satrgb.g), satrgb.b);
    float satadj = m.z * highlightcoeff + m.w * shadowcoeff;
    sat += sat * satadj * min(1.0, 2.0 - 2.0 * sat * satadj);
    float mult = 1.0 / (luma.x + pow(0.125, m.x * highlightcoeff + m.y * shadowcoeff) * (1.0 - luma.x));
    s *= mult; luma *= mult; 
    satrgb = max(((luma - s) / (luma - 1.0)), (luma - s) / luma);
    float newsat = max(max(satrgb.r, satrgb.g), satrgb.b);
    float satmult = sat / newsat;
    s = luma + (s - luma) * satmult;
    s.a = 1.0;
	 s.rgb += delta; 
    s = vec4(max(s.r, s_orig.r), max(s.g, s_orig.g), max(s.b, s_orig.b), 1.0); 
    return s;

    m = m * vec4(highlightcoeff, shadowcoeff, highlightcoeff, shadowcoeff);
    vec4 satrgb = max(((luma - s) / (luma - 1.0)), (luma - s) / luma);
    float sat = max(max(satrgb.r, satrgb.g), satrgb.b);
    float satadj = m.z * highlightcoeff + m.w * shadowcoeff;
    sat += sat * satadj * min(1.0, 2.0 - 2.0 * sat * satadj);
    float mult = 1.0 / (luma.x + pow(0.125, m.x * highlightcoeff + m.y * shadowcoeff) * (1.0 - luma.x));
    s *= mult; luma *= mult; 
    satrgb = max(((luma - s) / (luma - 1.0)), (luma - s) / luma);
    float newsat = max(max(satrgb.r, satrgb.g), satrgb.b);

    s.a = 1.0;
	 s.rgb += delta; 
    s = vec4(max(s.r, s_orig.r), max(s.g, s_orig.g), max(s.b, s_orig.b), 1.0);

    float highlightcoeff = luma.x * luma.x * (3.0 - 2.0 * luma.x);
    float shadowcoeff = 1.0 - highlightcoeff;
    m = m * vec4(highlightcoeff, shadowcoeff, highlightcoeff, shadowcoeff);
    vec4 satrgb = max(((luma - s) / (luma - 1.0)), (luma - s) / luma);
    float sat = max(max(satrgb.r, satrgb.g), satrgb.b);
    float satadj = m.z * highlightcoeff + m.w * shadowcoeff;
    sat += sat * satadj * min(1.0, 2.0 - 2.0 * sat * satadj);
    float mult = 1.0 / (luma.x + pow(0.125, m.x * highlightcoeff + m.y * shadowcoeff) * (1.0 - luma.x));
    s *= mult; luma *= mult; 
    satrgb = max(((luma - s) / (luma - 1.0)), (luma - s) / luma);
    float newsat = max(max(satrgb.r, satrgb.g), satrgb.b);
    float satmult = sat / newsat;
    s = luma + (s - luma) * satmult;
    s.a = 1.0;
